effects.name: Bleed
effects.behavior: Deals Physical Damage to the target each round for 2 rounds.

effects.name: Panic
effects.behavior: Deals Tactical Damage to the target each round.

effects.name: Burn
effects.behavior: Deals Fire Damage to the target each round.

effects.name: First-Strike
effects.behavior: Enables the dragon to act before all other combatants each round.

effects.name: Double-Strike
effects.behavior: Grants the target a second Basic Attack each round.

effects.name: Recovery
effects.behavior: Healing effect that restores troops over time.

effects.name: Advantage
effects.behavior: Increases Damage Dealt.

effects.name: Resistance
effects.behavior: Reduces Damage Received.

effects.name: Slow
effects.behavior: Causes the target to attack after all other combatant each round.

effects.name: Weakened
effects.behavior: Reduces Damage Dealt.

effects.name: Vulnerable
effects.behavior: Increases Damage Received.

effects.name: Prey
effects.behavior: Modify the target's Recovery Received.

effects.name: Evade
effects.behavior: Causes each instance of damage against the target to have a chance to be ignored.

effects.name: Cleanse
effects.behavior: Removes negative effects for Ally or removes positive effects for Enemy.

effects.name: Taunt
effects.behavior: Forces the target to launch their Basic Attack against this dragon.

effects.name: Stun
effects.behavior: Prevents the target from taking actions to activating Command and Habits, or launching Basic Attack on their turn.

effects.name: Overwhelm
effects.behavior: Prevents the target from using Commands and Habits on their turn.

effects.name: Stagger
effects.behavior: Prevents the target from using Attack Modifier Commands or launching Basic Attack on their turn.

effects.name: Confusion
effects.behavior: Causes the target to have a 50% chance to mistake Allies for Enemies and vice versa each time they activate a Command or Habits or launch a Basic Attack on their turn.

effects.name: Protect
effects.behavior: Damage dealt to the protected target by Commands and Habits is split between that target and the dragon that applied Protect.
effects.scope_note: The official Vermithor profile defines Command and Habit damage only; do not extend Protect to Basic Attacks or other damage without in-game evidence.

effects.name: Solar Flare
effects.behavior: A mark Starshower applies to enemy dragons at the start of combat and can consume when dealing Tactical Damage.
effects.scope_note: The public profile does not state an independent effect while the mark remains; treat it as a Starshower resource, not a generic debuff.
